title: Preparing for Umrah
lead: A full bath before ihram — for cleanliness, not to remove ritual impurity.
html:
Sunnah

A full bath before ihram — for cleanliness, not to remove ritual impurity.

  • The day before (31.10)Before you leave: trim your nails and moustache, remove the hair under the arms and in the groin area.
  • Do ghusl: rinse the mouth, rinse the nose, wash the whole body.
  • Put perfume on your body (not on the ihram cloth).
Men: if after Umrah you want only to shorten your hair (taqsir), do not cut it short before the trip. The hair must be longer than a finger joint (≈ 2 cm), otherwise only shaving is possible (step 11).
Moreif ghusl is not possible
  • If ghusl is not possible, ordinary ablution (wudu) is enough.

title: Ihram clothing

tags.text: Wajib · no sewn clothing, before the miqat

lead: The ihram itself is the intention and the talbiyah (steps 4–5). From this moment a man may not wear sewn clothing, and you must enter ihram before the miqat of Dhul-Hulayfah (for an Umrah from Makkah — outside the Haram boundary; the closest place is Tan'im, Masjid Aisha) — this is wajib. Two white unsewn sheets are sunnah: this was the dress of the Prophet ﷺ.
html:
Wajib · no sewn clothing, before the miqatSunnah · 2 white sheets

The ihram itself is the intention and the talbiyah (steps 4–5). From this moment a man may not wear sewn clothing, and you must enter ihram before the miqat of Dhul-Hulayfahoutside the Haram boundary — the closest place is Tan'im (Masjid Aisha) — this is wajib. Two white unsewn sheets are sunnah: this was the dress of the Prophet ﷺ.

“Can I skip it and pay with a sacrifice instead?” — No. A wajib is obligatory. A dam sacrifice repairs the Umrah if a violation has already happened, but it does not make the violation allowed: breaking a wajib on purpose is a sin, and repentance is also needed. Expiation is for a mistake, an illness or a forced reason, not a payment in advance.
  • Izar — the lower sheet, wrapped around the waist, covers from the navel to below the knees.
  • Rida — the upper sheet, over the shoulders.
  • Sandals that leave the top of the foot uncovered. A money belt is allowed.
  • Underwear, socks, a cap, sewn clothing.
  • Women — wear their usual modest clothing; sewn clothes are allowed, any colour. The face stays uncovered: fabric must not touch the face.
Another Umrah from Makkah. You put on the ihram clothing at the hotel, then take a taxi to Tan'im (Masjid Aisha, ≈ 7.5 km from the Haram) — there you pray 2 rak'ahs, make the intention and say the talbiyah, then go back to the Haram for tawaf. You do not enter ihram for Umrah inside the Haram boundary — this breaks a wajib. If this has happened, go outside the boundary before you start tawaf and say the talbiyah there; for details, ask a scholar of Hanafi fiqh.
Moreidtiba, where to change
  • Before tawaf — idtiba: the right shoulder is uncovered, the rida goes under the right arm.
We put on the clothing at the hotel, but the intention and the talbiyah are made at the miqat (steps 4 and 5). Until then, the prohibitions do not apply yet.

title: 2 rak'ahs of ihram
lead: Two rak'ahs with the intention “prayer of ihram”. Ihram has not started yet — you may cover your head.
html:
Sunnah

Two rak'ahs with the intention “prayer of ihram”. Ihram has not started yet — you may cover your head.

1st rak'ah, after al-Fatihah
قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
Surah al-Kafirun (109)
2nd rak'ah, after al-Fatihah
قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
Surah al-Ikhlas (112)
Moreprayer times
  • If it is the time of a fard prayer (zuhr), you may pray zuhr instead of them.
  • When you may not pray: while the sun is rising (≈20 min after sunrise), at the zenith (≈10 min before zuhr), while the sun is setting (≈20 min before maghrib). It is also undesirable after fajr until sunrise and after asr until sunset. Wait, then pray. Prayer times for your location and the qibla are .

title: Intention
lead: The intention is in the heart. Saying it aloud is recommended.

dua.label: Intention for Umrah
dua.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ فَيَسِّرْهَا لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي
dua.tr: Allahumma inni uridul-'umrata fa-yassirha li wa taqabbalha minni
dua.ru: “O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah — make it easy for me and accept it from me”
dua.src: A formula from Hanafi fiqh books (al-Hidayah and others)

html:
Fard · shart (condition)

The intention is in the heart. Saying it aloud is recommended.

Intention for Umrah
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ فَيَسِّرْهَا لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي
Allahumma inni uridul-'umrata fa-yassirha li wa taqabbalha minni
“O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah — make it easy for me and accept it from me”
A formula from Hanafi fiqh books (al-Hidayah and others)
Right after the intention — talbiyah (step 5). From this moment you are in ihram and the prohibitions apply (see the “Ihram prohibitions” card below).

title: Talbiyah

dua.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
dua.tr: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk. Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk. La sharika lak.
dua.ru: “Here I am before You, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Truly, praise, grace and dominion are Yours. You have no partner”.

html:
Fard · once, with the intentionSunnah · repeat it
لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Labbayk Allahumma labbayk. Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk. La sharika lak.
“Here I am before You, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Truly, praise, grace and dominion are Yours. You have no partner”.
al-Bukhari 1549, Muslim 1184
  • Men say it aloud, loudly. Repeat it on the way, when going up and when going down.
  • You stop it at the start of tawaf (at the Black Stone).

title: Entering the mosque

dua.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
dua.tr: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
dua.ru: “In the name of Allah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy”.

html:
Sunnah
  • Meeting point: remember the gate number and take a photo of it.
  • Shoes — in a bag, then in your backpack.
  • Enter with your right foot and read:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulillah. Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
“In the name of Allah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy”.
Muslim 713; Abu Dawud 465
First sight of the Kaaba — raise your hands, say “Allahu akbar, la ilaha illallah” and ask Allah for what matters most to you.

title: Tawaf
lead: At the Black Stone, stand facing it, raise your hands with the palms facing the Stone, say “Bismillahi wallahu akbar” and kiss the inside of your palms. Do this at the start of each of the 7 rounds and after the 7th (8 times in total); you can keep walking without stopping. Do not push your way to the Stone.

dua.label: At the Black Stone · at the start of each round
dua.ru: “In the name of Allah, Allah is Great”

html:
Fard · 4 roundsWajib · 3 rounds, wudu
  • It must be done with ablution (wudu).
  • Idtiba — the right shoulder is uncovered for all 7 rounds.
  • Ramal — in the first 3 rounds, walk fast with your shoulders forward (if the crowd allows).
  1. 1
    Start — opposite the Black Stone (green lamp on the wall).
  2. 2
    The Kaaba is on your left, walk anticlockwise.
  3. 3
    Walk outside the Hijr of Ismail (the semicircular wall).
  4. 4
    Yemeni Corner — touch it with your hand if there is space (do not kiss it).
  5. 5
    Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone — the du'a “Our Lord! Give us good…” (below).

A guiding diagram, not to scale.

Round counter
1234567
Morelost count, wheelchair

Lost count? Take the smaller number. Yemeni Corner — touch it with your hand if there is space (do not kiss it). On the way — any du'a, dhikr, Quran.

Start each round exactly at the line of the Black Stone — this is the safest way. If walking is hard for you (age, illness, after surgery), tawaf in a wheelchair is allowed for a valid reason.

Istilam and du'a

Sunnah

At the Black Stone, stand facing it, raise your hands with the palms facing the Stone, say “Bismillahi wallahu akbar” and kiss the inside of your palms. Do this at the start of each of the 7 rounds and after the 7th (8 times in total); you can keep walking without stopping. Do not push your way to the Stone.

At the Black Stone · at the start of each round
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
Bismillahi wallahu akbar
“In the name of Allah, Allah is Great”
al-Bukhari 1613 (takbir); al-Bayhaqi — from Ibn Umar
Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone
رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah, wa fil-akhirati hasanah, wa qina 'adhaban-nar
“Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Last Life, and protect us from the torment of the Fire”
Quran 2:201 (translation of the meaning); Abu Dawud 1892

title: 2 rak'ahs at Maqam Ibrahim

dua.ru: “Make the place of Ibrahim a place of prayer”

html:
Wajib
  • Cover your right shoulder (idtiba is over).
  • On the way to the Maqam, you may read:
وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ مُصَلًّى
Wattakhidhu mim-maqami Ibrahima musalla
“Make the place of Ibrahim a place of prayer”
Quran 2:125 (translation of the meaning)
  • 2 rak'ahs: al-Kafirun and al-Ikhlas, as in step 3.
  • Crowded? Pray anywhere in the mosque — this is even better than getting in the way of people doing tawaf.
  • At an undesirable time (sunrise, zenith, sunset, after fajr and after asr), wait and pray later.

title: Zamzam

dua.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا، وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
dua.tr: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan wasi'an, wa shifa'an min kulli da'
dua.ru: “O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision and healing from every illness”

html:
Mustahabb
  • Drink standing, facing the Kaaba, as much as you like, in three sips, starting with “Bismillah”. The Prophet ﷺ drank Zamzam standing (al-Bukhari 1637).
  • A little water — on your head and face.
  • Ask for what you need: “Zamzam water is for whatever it is drunk for” (Ibn Majah 3062).
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا، وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan wasi'an, wa shifa'an min kulli da'
“O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision and healing from every illness”
Words of Ibn Abbas (ad-Daraqutni)
Then go back to the Black Stone: istilam with your hand from a distance, then on to Safa (sunnah).
Moreabout the du'a of Ibn Abbas
⚑ To check: the du'a of Ibn Abbas has a weak isnad; read it as an ordinary du'a.

title: Sa'i: Safa

dua.label: Between the green lights
dua.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْأَعَزُّ الْأَكْرَمُ
dua.ru: “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous”
dua.src: Words of Ibn Mas'ud and Ibn Umar (Ibn Abi Shaybah)

html:
Wajib
Approaching Safa (once)
إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ · أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
Innas-safa wal-marwata min sha'a'irillah. Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih.
“As-Safa and al-Marwah are among the rite-signs of Allah”. “I begin with what Allah began with”.
Quran 2:158 (translation of the meaning); Muslim 1218
On Safa and on Marwah · facing the Kaaba, hands raised
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ×٣ · لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
Allahu akbar ×3. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
Muslim 1218. Then your own du'a.

Sa'i: 7 laps

  • Safa → Marwah = 1, Marwah → Safa = 2 … you finish at Marwah (7).
  • Between the green lights men walk fast.

A guiding diagram, not to scale. The dot shows where to go now.

Lap counter
S→MM→SS→MM→SS→MM→SS→M
Between the green lights
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْأَعَزُّ الْأَكْرَمُ
Rabbighfir warham, innaka antal-a'azzul-akram
“My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous”
Words of Ibn Mas'ud and Ibn Umar (Ibn Abi Shaybah)
Moreablution, rest, to check
  • Ablution is recommended, but not required.
  • Tired? You may rest, sit down, have a drink. Wheelchairs are available.
⚑ To check: this du'a is reported from the Companions, not from the Prophet ﷺ. You may read any du'a.

title: Shaving the head
lead: Halq — shaving the whole head (better). Taqsir — shortening the hair by at least the length of a finger joint.

dua.label: After Umrah
dua.ru: “Praise be to Allah”. May Allah accept our Umrah!

html:
Wajib

Halq — shaving the whole head (better). Taqsir — shortening the hair by at least the length of a finger joint.

  • For Hanafis the minimum is a quarter of the head, but the whole head is better.
  • The ihram prohibitions are lifted only after shaving. Umrah is complete!
  • Prices at barbers differ and change — ask before they start. A barber who uses a single-use blade is better.
Another Umrah on this trip. If your head is already shaved, pass a razor over the whole head again (Hanafis require this). Women again shorten their hair by the length of a finger joint.
Hair shorter than a finger joint (≈ 2 cm)? There is nothing to shorten — a man needs shaving (halq). Cutting “three hairs” is not enough for Hanafis: at least a quarter of the head is needed. Women do not shave their heads — they only shorten the hair by a finger joint.
⚑ To check: whether a clipper “to zero” without a blade counts as shaving — ask a scholar of Hanafi fiqh. A razor is safer.
The Prophet ﷺ asked for forgiveness three times for those who shaved their heads and once for those who shortened their hair (al-Bukhari 1727, Muslim 1302).
After Umrah
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
Al-hamdu lillah
“Praise be to Allah”. May Allah accept our Umrah!
